verdict.rationale: telli documents a REST API with bearer-token auth and publishes an OpenAPI spec (verified by probe) that users can download to generate their own client libraries or feed to coding agents. No first-party SDK package is evidenced, so building against an SDK means generating a client yourself. Missing for 10: official first-party SDKs in any language, SDK documentation or installation guides, maintained package distribution, independent corroboration of SDK usage.
